description: Recommended intakes (RDA/AI; UK RNI and EAR), upper limits (UL, with scope e.g. "supplemental only"; CDRR; UK "less than" goals as MAX) and label reference values (DV/RI/NRV) for a population and jurisdiction. Each value carries its source, a cite line and its jurisdiction; a value another held jurisdiction supplied for a class the asked one lacks carries fallback: true, and fallback_jurisdictions lists them.

jurisdiction.description: Whose reference values: US (NIH ODS RDA/AI/UL, Dietary Guidelines CDRR, FDA Daily Values), EU (Regulation 1169/2011 RI/NRV) or UK (its assimilated Annex XIII RI/NRV and Public Health England's Government Dietary Recommendations: RNI, EAR and "less than" MAX goals). CA is accepted but holds no values of its own (no Canadian publication of them allows commercial reproduction): a Canadian question is answered with US, UK and EU values, each labelled with its jurisdiction and fallback: true. Each jurisdiction's own values come first; for a property and kind it does not hold, another held jurisdiction's values follow, each labelled with its own jurisdiction and fallback: true, never presented as the asked one. A jurisdiction not listed (AU, ...) is refused with this list, never answered with an empty list.

name: reference_values
